correctness.rationale: In the specified k equal-size disjoint approval blocs and k seats, JR forces exactly one seat per bloc; higher EJR/PJR levels are vacuous since every group with a nonempty common approved candidate lies in one quota-sized bloc. Thus C=Σ block maxima and U=globally top k of kq, giving tail-binomial exact expectation integrals. The variational top-k representation U=min_s(ks+Σ(X-s)_+) and positive density at t=F^-1(1-1/q) yield a sample-quantile O_p(k^-1/2) band and O_p(1)=o_p(sqrt k) linearization error. Independent block CLT and delta method give the coupled deficit and ratio variances; finite second moment supports finite variance. Independent exact rational checks reproduce uniform finite deficit for 91 (k,q) cases, σ²(q=2)=1/72, σ²(q=3)=257/19440, and ratio τ²(q=2)=52/2187. The unrestricted CLT follows analytically from block independence and quantile linearization, not simulations.

value.rationale: The natural equal-sized party-list JR stress test quantifies the stochastic loss of a binding representation quota relative to a genuinely optimal global top-k committee. Its exact finite expectation and tight 8/9 uniform asymptotic floor for q≥2, alongside coupled Gaussian deficit and ratio variances, yield useful magnitude and uncertainty benchmarks beyond the already studied worst-case quality tradeoffs.

limitations: Disjoint equal-sized approval blocs, iid qualities and fixed q; no assertions for general approvals, quality dependence or jointly growing q.
Positive density at target quantile and finite second moment are needed for the CLT; finite exact checks are not a substitute for the CLT proof.
